meta.title: KMCODE — Private, supported smart home installation
meta.description: KMCODE installs your smart home: lighting, heating, smart cameras, voice assistant. Your data stays at home, no mandatory subscription.

hero.subtitle: Lighting, heating, cameras, voice assistant: KMCODE installs, configures and looks after your smart home. Your data stays at home, and nothing forces you to subscribe.

brands.title: Works with the devices you already have
brands.text: Appliances, speakers, robot vacuum, heating, lighting: we connect your brands together, without locking you into any of them.

subscription.a: No. Your installation works without a subscription and you keep everything. Serenity adds monitoring, updates and remote troubleshooting, with no commitment.

hardware.a: Your choice: we supply it at retail price, or you buy it yourself from the list we give you. Either way, it belongs to you.

works.a: Usually not: most devices are wireless. If your project involves the fuse box or in-wall modules, a partner insured electrician handles it, quoted separately.

internet.q: What happens if the internet goes down?
internet.a: Your home keeps working normally, because everything runs locally. Only remote access pauses during the outage.

alarm.q: Do the cameras replace an alarm?
alarm.a: No. They detect and alert you, but they don't replace a certified alarm recognised by insurers. We don't sell alarms or monitoring services.

ai.a: It's optional and off by default. If you turn it on (a smarter voice assistant, camera alerts described in one sentence), it runs on your own account, for a few euros a month paid directly to the provider.

zone.a: In Montpellier and within about 15 km. Further away, get in touch: we'll see together what is possible. The assessment can also be done by video call.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Where your data lives, how long it is kept and who can access it: the full picture, in plain words.
data.intro: Your smart home runs at your place, on your hub. Here is exactly what stays there, what leaves, for how long, and who can access it.

sections.title: In short
list: Your settings, device history and camera footage stay on your hub, at home.
Only two things go to KMCODE: the health status of your installation (online, versions, errors) and an encrypted backup.
A few technical services make notifications and remote access work. Everything else (artificial intelligence, cloud voice) is only enabled if you ask for it.
You own everything, and you can cut our access at any time.

sections.title: Our commitments
list: Cameras: technically, an administrator can see everything. We commit in writing to never view your footage, and every connection we make is logged.
Maintenance access: a KMCODE account separate from yours, which you can disable at any time.
Backup key: it is handed to you. We keep a sealed copy, used only at your request to restore your installation.
Artificial intelligence: off by default. For cameras, you pick which ones, one by one; never bedrooms without your explicit request.
Ownership: the hardware, administrator accounts, passwords and data are yours.

Accounts in your name: your installation is never tied to a KMCODE or personal account. Any accounts needed (app, optional subscriptions) are created with your email address, in front of you, and you choose the passwords.
Local cameras: they connect to your hub with no manufacturer account or cloud service, except mobile-network cameras, which require one.
Technical passwords (cameras, recovery account): they are handed to you on a paper sheet at installation.
Leaving: when the contract ends, we hand over the documentation and access, remove our account and remote access, then delete our copies within 30 days, with a written confirmation.

about.title: About us
about.description: KMCODE, smart home installation in Montpellier: a developer passionate about home automation, installing at your place what he uses at home.
about.intro: KMCODE is Kevin Morize: a developer who has worked for large companies, passionate about home automation and new technology, based in Montpellier.

sections.title: Why KMCODE
text: Smart homes are often sold with a mandatory subscription, a distant cloud and devices that don't talk to each other. We believe a smart home should run at your place first, stay yours, and keep working even without internet.
KMCODE installs smart homes that are local, private and looked after: you stay in control, and we watch over the installation if you wish.

sections.title: Tested at home first
text: Everything we offer runs every day at Kevin's home before being installed at yours: smart lighting and heating, cameras that recognise a person or a crying baby, a wall tablet, a voice assistant, energy tracking, power-cut alerts.
list: A developer's standards: reliable hardware, updates checked before being installed, backups.
A privacy standard: your data stays at home, and our commitments are in writing.
A clarity standard: fixed-price packages and hardware at retail price.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.description: KMCODE terms of sale: assessment, smart home installation and Serenity plans.
terms.intro: These terms apply to the services of {name} ({form}, {rcs}, {address}, France) for private customers: assessment, smart home installation, options and Serenity plans. This translation is provided for convenience; the French version prevails.

sections.title: 1. Quote and order
text: Every installation is covered by a detailed quote (package, options, hardware), valid for 30 days. The order is placed when the quote is signed and the deposit paid.
The assessment (€79 incl. VAT) is invoiced separately; its amount is deducted from the installation if you order it within 30 days.

sections.title: 2. Prices
text: Prices are in euros, including VAT. Hardware is invoiced at the retail price shown on the quote; you may also buy it yourself from the list we provide.
Any work outside your plan or subscription is billed at €65 per hour, including VAT.
Travel is included in Montpellier and within about 15 km. Beyond that, any travel costs are shown on the quote.

sections.title: 3. Payment
list: Installation: 30% deposit on order, balance at the end of the installation, by bank transfer.
Serenity plan: monthly, by SEPA direct debit or bank transfer, at the start of each month.
Late payments may incur interest at the French statutory rate after formal notice.

sections.title: 4. Right of withdrawal
text: When the contract is concluded at your home or at a distance, you have 14 days to withdraw, without giving a reason, from signature (services) or receipt of the hardware (hardware supplied by KMCODE). Simply notify us by email at {email}, for example using the form below.

If you expressly ask for the installation to start before this period ends, the amount for work already done remains due if you withdraw. The right of withdrawal no longer applies to a service fully performed with your express consent.

sections.title: 5. Carrying out the installation
text: We agree on a date together. You give us access to the premises, your internet connection and the accounts of existing devices. The installation ends with a hands-on walkthrough with you.
Electrical work (fuse board, in-wall modules) is not carried out by KMCODE: it is entrusted to an insured partner electrician, under a separate quote.

sections.title: 6. Hardware and warranties
text: Hardware supplied by KMCODE becomes yours once fully paid. It is covered by the French legal guarantee of conformity (2 years) and the guarantee against hidden defects, as well as the manufacturer's warranty.
Our work is guaranteed for 3 months: during this period we fix free of charge any configuration fault on our side.

sections.title: 7. Serenity plans
text: The Serenity (€19 incl. VAT/month) and Serenity+ (€35 incl. VAT/month) plans have no commitment. Their content is described on the Offers page. You can cancel at any time by email; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current month.

We commit to handling your requests within 2 business days (Serenity) or 1 business day (Serenity+). Excluded: failures of hardware, of your internet connection or of third-party services, and changes beyond what your plan includes.

sections.title: 8. Liability
text: KMCODE is bound by an obligation of means. The cameras and detections offered are not a certified alarm or monitoring service and do not replace an installation recognised by insurers.
Artificial intelligence options and third-party services operate under their providers' terms.

sections.title: 9. Personal data
text: The processing of your data is described in the privacy policy and on the “Your data” page, whose commitments are part of the contract.

sections.title: 10. End of contract and reversibility
text: When a plan ends, your installation keeps working. We hand over the documentation and access, remove our account and remote access, and delete our backup copies within 30 days.

sections.title: 11. Complaints and mediation
text: For any complaint, write to us at {email}. If no agreement is reached, you may use a consumer mediator free of charge. {mediatorEn}
These terms are governed by French law.
